newsitem.title: FRANCE: Five wheat ships expected in Rouen by October 31.
newsitem.headline: Five wheat ships expected in Rouen by October 31.

text.p: Five ships were expected in Rouen by October 31 to load a combined 91,000 tonnes of soft wheat, port officials said on Tuesday.
One ship was also expected in Rouen by October 31 to load 50,000 tonnes of barley, they said.
Destinations for the wheat and the barley were not specified.
In Rouen three ships are currently loading a total of 61,700 tonnes of soft wheat destined for Egypt and Italy.
One ship is also loading 3,300 tonnes of barley destined for Italy.
